title.zh: 尽量减少恶意软件的传播

desc.zh: 从删除感染源后的再次感染，推导连通分量的唯一感染源规则。
desc.en: Derive the sole-seed component rule by watching infection return after a seed is removed.

concepts.name: Connected components
concepts.description: A component is saved exactly when its only initial seed is removed.

concepts.name: Graph traversal
concepts.description: Infection reaches every node reachable from a remaining seed.
